EDGE OF MY MIND  -  A New novel by Stuart Warner Phelps
There is no meeting of the minds when Martin Peters is sucked into the world of the 
aliens, no hands across the universe, only pain and suffering 
Alien abduction
Darkly dramatic
Graphic and disturbing
Intriguing ending
Credible storyline
Five star sci-fi
Captured, aboard a UFO, disinterested and uncaring aliens experiment on him, treating 
him little more than a laboratory animal. With his body slowly degenerating as alien viruses 
attack his system, he moves closer to death. Machines invade his mind and memory, once 
they have stripped him of every ounce of information his ruined body is unceremoniously 
dumped back on earth.
Close to death a new nightmare unfolds as humans take control, subjecting him to their 
own regime of tests, determined to uncover the mysterious phenomenon locked deep 
within.
Edge of my Mind has a dark storyline that takes you on a journey into the unknown, it 
grips and leaves you wondering just who Martin Peters should fear most. Aliens seeking 
information on the human race, or humans searching for the truth of the aliens
One thing is certain, whilst each have their own agendas, the welfare of Martin Peters 
doesn’t figure on either. 
EDGE OF MY MIND ISBN; 978-1-60911-216-5, on sale now. Available from Amazon, 
Barnes & Noble, Bookstore.co.uk, Waterstone’s, and others.
